description: Migrate reviews from the in-screen INITIAL_REVIEWS array to Firestore per business (businesses/{businessId}/reviews). Add the useBusinessReviews hook, convert BusinessScreen to receive reviews via props with a Promise-returning onSubmitReview (clear inputs only on success), guard avgRating against the empty list, and wire the business.tsx wrapper to the hook with optimistic prepend + rollback. reviews.ts exists from FEAT-001. Depends on FEAT-002 (needs account.name/uid). Independent of FEAT-003/005/006.
steps: Create src/hooks/useBusinessReviews.ts (outside src/app per AGENTS.md): useBusinessReviews(businessId: string) runs a load effect with [businessId] in deps, resetting reviews=[] and loading=true at the start of each run, calling reviews.listReviews(businessId). Returns { reviews, loading, submitting, errorMessage, submitReview } where submitReview(rating, comment): Promise<void> does the optimistic prepend of a mapped Review, calls reviews.addReview with author/authorUid from the signed-in profile, rejects (rethrows) on write failure after rolling back the optimistic item and setting errorMessage, and never sorts on a null createdAt. Map ReviewDoc -> the screen's Review ({ id, author, rating, comment }).

Edit src/screens/BusinessScreen.tsx: remove the local useState<Review[]>(INITIAL_REVIEWS) and the INITIAL_REVIEWS constant; add props reviews: Review[], reviewsLoading?: boolean, submitting?: boolean, onSubmitReview: (rating:number, comment:string)=>Promise<void>. Keep newRating/newComment local. Change the submit handler to async: guard (newRating===0 || !newComment.trim() || submitting) return; try await onSubmitReview(newRating, newComment.trim()); then clear newRating/newComment ONLY on resolve; catch keep inputs. Guard avgRating: reviews.length ? sum/length : 0. Keep the disabled-until-valid rule and the submit-disabled-while-submitting behavior. KEEP the existing const { isFavorite, toggleFavorite } = useAccount() import/line for favorites.

Edit src/app/business.tsx: call useBusinessReviews(item.id) and pass reviews, reviewsLoading, submitting, onSubmitReview down to BusinessScreen. The wrapper owns author = useAccount().account?.name ?? 'Voce' and authorUid = account?.uid, the optimistic prepend, the createdAt-desc ordering (via the Firestore query, not client sort), rollback + errorMessage on failure, and rethrows so the screen keeps inputs.
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` and fix any errors.
acceptance_criteria: BusinessScreen lists reviews from Firestore businesses/{businessId}/reviews, not from a fixed array (AC-15); INITIAL_REVIEWS no longer exists in the screen.
Submitting a review with rating>0 and non-empty comment writes to Firestore and the new review appears at the top; the submit button stays disabled when rating or comment is missing (AC-16).
Displayed average and count derive from the Firestore-backed list and the empty list renders 0.0 / 0 avaliacoes rather than NaN (AC-17).
onSubmitReview returns Promise<void>; the screen clears inputs only on resolve and keeps them on rejection; createdAt null is never dereferenced.
`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx expo lint` both pass (AC-30).
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from the worktree root and confirm zero errors.
Run `npx expo lint` from the worktree root and confirm zero errors.
Confirm (read BusinessScreen.tsx) INITIAL_REVIEWS is gone, reviews come from props, avgRating is guarded, and the useAccount favorites line remains.
findings: Implemented. Created src/hooks/useBusinessReviews.ts (outside src/app): loads via reviews.listReviews on a [businessId] effect, resets reviews=[]/loading=true/errorMessage=null at the start of each run using the React 'adjust state when a prop changes' render-time pattern (a useRef/ref-during-render variant was rejected because react-hooks/refs forbids reading/writing refs during render; a synchronous setState at the top of the effect body was rejected because react-hooks/set-state-in-effect forbids it). submitReview(rating, comment): Promise<void> reads author = account?.name ?? 'Você' and authorUid = account?.uid ?? '' from useAccount, optimistically prepends a mapped Review, swaps the optimistic id for the saved id on success, and on failure removes the optimistic item, sets errorMessage, and rethrows so inputs are kept. Maps ReviewDoc -> Review { id, author, rating, comment } and never touches the null createdAt (ordering stays in the Firestore orderBy query). BusinessScreen.tsx: removed INITIAL_REVIEWS and the local useState<Review[]>; added props reviews/reviewsLoading/submitting/onSubmitReview; submit handler is async, guards (rating===0 || empty comment || submitting), awaits onSubmitReview and clears inputs only on resolve (keeps them on reject); avgRating guarded to 0 for the empty list; submit button disabled while submitting; kept the useAccount favorites line unchanged. business.tsx: calls useBusinessReviews(item?.id ?? '') before the !item guard and passes reviews/reviewsLoading/submitting/onSubmitReview down. Verification: npx tsc --noEmit = 0 errors; npx expo lint = 0 errors (one pre-existing unrelated react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warning in src/screens/DiscoverScreen.tsx, untouched by this feature). Note: tsc/lint do not prove Firestore runtime behavior; real read/write needs manual Expo Go smoke testing.
